plants.name: Prunus × yedoensis
plants.description: A graceful deciduous tree that produces clouds of pale pink to nearly white five-petaled flowers before its leaves emerge. It is the most widely planted ornamental cherry in Japan and is celebrated in hanami festivals. Trees are often planted along rivers, in parks, and around temples.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late March to mid-April (peak varies by latitude; late March in Tokyo, Washington D.C., and similar climates)
plants.location: Japan, Korea, eastern United States, and temperate regions worldwide
plants.funFact: The cherry trees around the Tidal Basin in Washington, D.C. were a gift from Tokyo in 1912, and their peak bloom date is closely tracked each year by the National Park Service.

plants.name: Narcissus pseudonarcissus
plants.description: A bulbous perennial with a bright yellow trumpet surrounded by paler yellow petals. It naturalizes in meadows, woodlands, and gardens, forming sweeping drifts of color in early spring. Cultivated hybrids are among the most popular spring bulbs.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late February to April in the Northern Hemisphere
plants.location: Western Europe (native), widely naturalized in North America and temperate gardens
plants.funFact: All parts of the daffodil contain lycorine and other alkaloids that are toxic, which is why deer and rodents generally avoid them. One compound, galantamine, is used in medicine for Alzheimer's disease.

plants.name: Cercis canadensis
plants.description: A small deciduous tree whose bare branches and even trunk become studded with clusters of magenta-pink, pea-like flowers before the heart-shaped leaves appear. It is a valuable early nectar source for native bees and a common sight in woodland edges and gardens.
plants.location: Eastern and central North America, from southern Ontario to northern Mexico
plants.funFact: Redbud flowers are edible and have a mildly tart flavor. The tree is cauliflorous, meaning blooms can emerge directly from the old wood of the trunk.

plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: A tropical to subtropical tree with fern-like foliage that bursts into masses of trumpet-shaped, lavender-blue flowers. In bloom, entire streets appear to be cloaked in purple, and fallen petals carpet the ground below.
plants.bloomingSeason: Spring in the Southern Hemisphere is September to November, but it blooms in autumn in some regions like parts of Northern Argentina and Northern Australia; in the tropics it flowers in March to May
plants.location: Native to South America; cultivated in Africa, Australia, India, and Mexico
plants.funFact: In Pretoria, South Africa, there are tens of thousands of jacarandas, earning it the nickname 'Jacaranda City', and the tree is widely planted across the tropics for its dramatic display.
